description: This file declares the media::AudioProcessor class, which applies audio processing effects such as echo cancellation and noise suppression to input audio streams, mainly relying on WebRTC's AudioProcessing module. It includes methods for processing captured audio, analyzing playout data, managing audio processing configurations, and handling diagnostics. The class is designed for multi-threaded use with specific thread annotations.

classes.name: media::AudioProcessor
classes.description: A class that manages audio processing effects such as echo cancellation and noise suppression, utilizing WebRTC's AudioProcessing module. It handles processing of captured audio, playout analysis, configuration management, and diagnostics, designed for multi-threaded environments.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate an AudioProcessor with specified callbacks, settings, and formats.

methods.name: ProcessCapturedAudio
methods.description: Processes incoming captured audio, delivering processed chunks via callback.

methods.name: OnPlayoutData
methods.description: Analyzes playout audio for echo cancellation and delay reporting.

methods.name: SetOutputWillBeMuted
methods.description: Instructs the processor to reduce complexity when muted.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics from the WebRTC audio processing module.

methods.name: GetAudioProcessingModuleConfigForTesting
methods.description: Returns current APM configuration for testing purposes.

methods.name: input_format
methods.description: Returns the input audio format used by the processor.

methods.name: output_format
methods.description: Returns the output audio format used by the processor.

methods.name: ComputeInputFormat
methods.description: Computes a compatible input format based on device format and settings.

methods.name: GetDefaultOutputFormat
methods.description: Provides an output format that minimizes delay and resampling.

methods.name: needs_playout_reference
methods.description: Indicates if playout data should be processed.
